name: The My Clips page follows the theme through the kit: as admin, with one Fast clip of the check's own on Long Test Movie ('page-clips-theme'; an earlier run's deleted first, its own deleted at the end with its bookmark), My Clips in Dark, Light, Apple TV and Purple Haze: the page's text is the theme's text colour, and the Rename clip dialog's surface, text and input are the theme's own with its accent on the primary button, as bookmarks-theme.json checks the editor. The theme is chosen per browser (localStorage '<userId>-appTheme', then a reload of the settled page); Dark is a fresh profile's theme, so My Clips is opened without a reload (a reload sent right after a hash navigation lands on Home, on jellyfin-web's own routes too).

steps.name: a clip of the check's own (an earlier run's deleted first)
steps.script: const auth = { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }; const mine = await (await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), { headers: auth })).json(); for (const b of mine.filter(x => x.Name === 'page-clips-theme')) await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: true }), { method: 'DELETE', headers: auth }); const movie = (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0]; const made = await (await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), { method: 'POST', headers: auth, body: JSON.stringify({ ItemId: movie.Id, StartTicks: 50000000, EndTicks: 80000000, Name: 'page-clips-theme' }) })).json(); const c = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + made.Id + '/Clip'), { method: 'POST', headers: auth, body: JSON.stringify({ Mode: 'Fast' }) }); if (c.status !== 202) throw new Error('clip ' + c.status); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const b = await (await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + made.Id), { headers: auth })).json(); if (b.Clip && b.Clip.Status === 'Completed') return { id: made.Id }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); } throw new Error('clip not ready');

steps.name: the page's colours (Dark)
steps.eval: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="clips"]'); return { pageColor: getComputedStyle(r).color, htmlColor: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).color }; })()

steps.name: the page's text is the theme's in every theme, and Light's differs from Dark's
in every theme the Rename clip dialog's surface, text and input are the theme's own
steps.assert: [__vars.dark, __vars.light, __vars.appletv, __vars.purplehaze].every(t => t.panelBackground === t.nativeDialogBackground && t.panelColor === t.htmlColor && t.inputBackground === t.nativeInputBackground)

steps.name: its primary button is the theme's accent, and Light's surface differs from Dark's
the check's clip and bookmark deleted
steps.script: const r = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.seed.id, { deleteClip: true }), { method: 'DELETE', headers: { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' } }); if (r.status !== 204) throw new Error('DELETE ' + r.status); return r.status;
